name: dealer-inventory-system
description: Dealer Inventory, Delivery, Billing and Payment Tracking System

scripts.setup: npm.cmd install && cd server && npm.cmd install && cd ../client && npm.cmd install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx.cmd prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx.cmd prisma db seed
